name: file_deleter
description: Soft-delete a file by renaming it with a _deleted suffix

name: file_download
description: 将工作区文件生成可下载链接，用户点击即可下载查看

name: file_reader
description: Read file contents or list directory entries

name: file_writer
description: Create or overwrite a file with content. File is written after user reviews and approves the preview.

name: handoff_to_sys
description:
当用户需要创建/修改/删除资源（工具、skill、模型），或需要写入 tools/skills/models 路径，
或当前工具集无法满足请求时调用。调用后任务将转交给系统工程师 Agent。

name: manage_hooks
description: Manage session lifecycle hooks. Hooks are external commands that run at specific session events (SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SessionEnd). Use 'list' to see current hooks, 'add' to register a new hook, 'remove' to delete a hook, 'update' to modify an existing hook. When a user wants automated actions (e.g., send email after tool execution, log to external service), register a PostToolUse hook with the appropriate command.

name: memory_store
description: Long-term memory that persists across conversations. Read current memories, write new ones (with automatic backup), check storage stats, and compress memories. Use 'read' to see stored memories, 'write' to persist new memories (merges with existing), 'stats' to check storage usage, 'compress' to consolidate memories using a specified model.

name: model_manager
description: Manage model resources: create, list, get, update, delete, test, and switch models. Use 'list' to see all configured models, 'create' to add a new model (quick_thinking, embedding, rerank, vision, tts, etc.), 'test' to verify connectivity, and 'switch' to change the active model.

name: model_switch
description: Switch the active model at runtime. Session starts with quick_thinking (reasoning, fast). Call this tool when: (1) simple tasks → use quick_thinking, (2) complex tasks or task retried >3 rounds → switch to deep_thinking. Degradation: if target level is unavailable, the next higher level is used automatically.

name: resource_loader
description: Activate or deactivate tools and skills on demand. Use 'list_active' to see available vs active tools, 'activate' to load tools discovered from skills, 'deactivate' to free resources. Kernel tools (file_reader, file_writer, file_deleter, resource_loader) cannot be deactivated.

name: resource_registrar
description: Query and request configuration for system resources. Use 'check' to verify if a resource is configured, 'list_pending' to see all unconfigured resources, 'check_deps' to verify dependencies.

name: web_fetch
description: 通过 HTTP GET 获取网页内容，伪装浏览器 User-Agent，返回纯文本

name: db_operator
description: SQLite database operations — create tables, insert, update, query

name: error_handler
description: Self-healing error handling — analyze tool errors, fix and retry

name: memory_compress
description: Compress and consolidate long-term memory to free up storage space. Run this when memory_store returns compression_needed=true (>=70% of 1MB) or during daily maintenance. Prefer using a quick_thinking (flash) model for compression.

name: memory_extract
description: Extract important information from the current conversation and persist it as long-term memory. Invoke after each assistant response when the conversation reveals user preferences, personal information, or other worth-remembering facts.

name: memory_management
description: Comprehensive guide for ARF's long-term memory system. Read this to understand the dual memory architecture, learn when and how to extract memories after conversations, and how to compress memories when storage fills up.

name: model_configurator
description: Configure models — add new model configs or modify existing ones

name: model_manager
description: Manage models — soft delete and restore

name: model_switch
description: Runtime model switching — choose the right model for the task complexity

name: resource_scaffold
description: Generate a new Tool or Skill resource from requirements

name: skill_generator
description: Generate new Skill definitions from user requirements

name: skill_manager
description: Manage skills — soft delete and restore

name: tool_generator
description: Generate new Tool definitions and implementations from user requirements

name: tool_manager
description: Manage tools — soft delete and restore

name: validate_tool
description: Validate a newly created tool by checking structure and dry-running

name: deep_thinking
description: 深度思考模型，用于复杂推理、代码生成等核心任务，是系统的必备模型

name: embedding
description: 嵌入模型，用于文本向量化，是 RAG 的依赖项

name: quick_no_thinking
description: 无思考快速模型，用于会话初始响应，不进行内部推理

name: quick_thinking
description: 快速思考模型，用于简单总结和摘要任务

name: rerank
description: 重排序模型，用于对检索结果进行精排，是 RAG 的依赖项

name: stt
description: 语音识别模型（Speech-to-Text），用于语音理解的依赖项

name: tts
description: 文字转语音模型（Text-to-Speech），用于语音输出的依赖项

name: vision
description: 视觉模型，用于图片理解的依赖项

name: vlm
description: 视觉语言模型，用于图片理解和 OCR 等视觉任务的依赖项
